author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
Too many so-called AI companies try to resell tokens with a marked up price. 

Don't resell tokens, no business will be stupid enough to let you archive vendor lock in. Data and know-how is our core competency, we won't let you take it hostage 

Sell service, sell support, sell reliability, that is something we don't want to deal with and we are happy to pay money to let someone take care of them for us.
